message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: build

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
      - release-*
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  build:
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os:
          - ubuntu-latest
          - windows-latest
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - name: Git Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Cache Go modules
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/go/pkg/mod
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-go-${{ hashFiles('**/go.mod', '**/go.sum') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-go-

      - name: Install Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v7
        with:
          go-version: stable

      - name: Install Ziti CI
        uses: openziti/ziti-ci@v1

      - name: Build and Test
        run: |
          go test ./...
          go test -C example ./...
          go install ./...

      # The secretstream package is a Go reimplementation of libsodium's
      # crypto_secretstream_xchacha20poly1305, so its wire format is only as good as a test
      # against libsodium itself. Those tests need cgo and the library, so they sit behind a
      # build tag and do not run under `go test ./...`; run them explicitly here, or the one
      # thing that can catch a divergence never runs.
      - name: Test secretstream against libsodium
        if: matrix.os == 'ubuntu-latest'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y libsodium-dev
          go test -count=1 -tags compat_test ./secretstream/...

      - name: Check license
        if: matrix.os == 'ubuntu-latest'
        run: |
          ./license-check.sh
          $(go env GOPATH)/bin/ziti-ci verify-version $($(go env GOPATH)/bin/sdk-version)
",
  "rationale": "Three evidence-supported optimizations are applied: (1) Go module caching (P-LIT-GHA-CACHE) to avoid repeated dependency downloads, supported by experiment batch-interactive-three--f6d2974a5cef7cc9 showing ~6% elapsed time reduction. (2) Custom job timeout (P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT) of 10 minutes to bound runaway runs, supported by experiments batch-interactive-three--112e2b2e7fbe04b8 (9.8% savings) and batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508 (26.8% savings). (3) Concurrency with cancel-in-progress (P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE) to supersede stale runs on the same branch/PR, supported by pattern catalogue simulation estimates. All changes preserve build/test coverage and required checks; no permissions or privileged actions are added.",
  "evidence_ids": [
    "experiment:batch-interactive-three--f6d2974a5cef7cc9",
    "pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE",
    "experiment:batch-interactive-three--112e2b2e7fbe04b8",
    "experiment:batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508",
    "pattern:P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT",
    "pattern:P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE"
  ]
}
